structured.approach: I read task.code and feat.stories and followed the backend-steps procedure for BE-06. Before editing, I used CodeGraph to see the source and blast radius of overdue_with_risk and overdue_rows_to_json; neither had a covering test. I added tests only in tests/test_aging.py, as TK-05.2 and SA-6 ask. They cover AC-05.1 to AC-05.10 and AC-06.1 to AC-06.4, plus checks that inputs are not modified and that the package exports the new functions. All test data is synthetic. I left out tests for behaviour that still depends on open questions (TQ-1, DQ-2, Q-2) and for a missing vendor on a paid or not-yet-overdue invoice. I ran /usr/bin/python3 ci.py until it passed, then ran codegraph sync and codegraph affected. task.unit_tests.md describes the test file as I read it. For the CI outcome it reports only the result the spine recorded: tests run, failures and coverage.

claims.text: The recorded unit-test result for ap_aging is: 16 run, 0 failing; coverage 100.0%.
ci.py sets the coverage gate as COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0.
The tests are added to tests/test_aging.py as two new classes, OverdueWithRiskTest and OverdueRowsToJsonTest. The existing AgingTest class is unchanged.
test_overdue_boundary_30_and_31 checks that an unpaid invoice 31 days past due is listed and one exactly 30 days past due is not, as AC-05.1, AC-05.2 and lesson L-007 require.

test_overdue_row_keys_and_sort checks that each row has exactly the keys id, vendor, days, amount and risk, and that rows are ordered by days descending and then id ascending, so SYN-INV-002 comes before SYN-INV-003 (AC-05.5, AC-05.6).
The tests check that Decimal("980.5") becomes "980.50" and that the CT-1 payload contains "amount": "1250.00" with no float conversion (AC-05.8, AC-06.2, D-2026-044, L-011).
test_existing_aging_unchanged patches bucket_for so that it raises if called, then confirms overdue_with_risk still returns its row. This verifies AC-05.9.
overdue_rows_to_json([]) is checked to return "[]", and each serialised object is checked to have no due_date field (AC-06.3, AC-06.4).

overdue_with_risk reads inv["vendor"] only after the paid and threshold checks. So only an overdue unpaid invoice without vendor raises KeyError, while AC-05.10 says that any invoice with no vendor key raises.
Every test name that task.code section 3 lists for BE-06 exists in tests/test_aging.py.

open_questions: UT-1 (non-blocking): AC-05.10 [Pending TQ-9] says any invoice with no vendor key raises KeyError, but the code raises only for an overdue unpaid invoice. Which behaviour is intended? Only the overdue unpaid case is tested. Architect (TQ-9) / PM.

UT-2 (non-blocking): codegraph affected reported 'No test files affected' for tests/test_aging.py and src/ap_aging/aging.py, even though the test file imports ap_aging.aging. The full CI suite was run instead. Platform team (CodeGraph).
Carried unchanged: task.code Q-2 (confirm version), PQ-2, TQ-1 (bucket_for(30) is deliberately not tested), TQ-3, TQ-9, DQ-2 (rounding mode is not tested), CQ-6.
structured.summary: I added unit tests to ap_aging tests/test_aging.py for overdue_with_risk (AC-05.1 to AC-05.10) and overdue_rows_to_json (AC-06.1 to AC-06.4). The tests also check that inputs are not modified and that the package exports the new functions. The recorded result is 16 run, 0 failing, coverage 100.0%, which is above the COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0 gate. The tests do not cover behaviour that still depends on open questions (TQ-1, DQ-2, Q-2). UT-1 asks whether the KeyError in AC-05.10 should apply to every invoice without a vendor or only to overdue unpaid ones. task.unit_tests.md is written and nothing is committed.
